en.subtitle: Wellness, learned by playing
en.short_description: A health-education game: care, diet, workout, breathing and wellness challenges.
en.description:
BodyQuest teaches wellness by letting you play with it, instead of lecturing you about it.

—— Six modules ——

CARE
The basics of looking after yourself, framed as something you do rather than something you read.

DIET
How food actually works, without a calorie ledger.

WORKOUT
Movement you can do without equipment or a gym membership.

EXPLORE
Wander through the topics and find what you did not know you wanted.

GAMES
The learning, as play.

BREATHE
Guided breathing, for when you need the simplest thing that works.

—— How it is set up ——

A one-time health disclaimer on first launch, then sign-in, then a dashboard across the six modules. There is a shop with product suggestions and an optional Premium upgrade.

—— Ads, purchases and shop links ——

BodyQuest is free and shows ads through Google AdMob. On iOS you will be asked whether the app may use your device's advertising identifier; you can decline and everything still works. An optional Premium upgrade is available. The Shop links out to Amazon and iHerb using affiliate tags, which means a purchase may earn us a commission at no extra cost to you.

—— Education, not medical advice ——

BodyQuest is a health-education game. It is not a medical device, it does not diagnose or treat anything, and nothing in it is medical advice — including any product shown in the Shop. Talk to a qualified clinician before changing your diet, starting an exercise programme, or taking any supplement.

review_information.notes:
Thanks for reviewing BodyQuest.

BodyQuest is a health-EDUCATION game across six modules. It shows ads via Google AdMob, offers an in-app Premium purchase, and its Shop links out to Amazon and iHerb with affiliate tags - all three are disclosed in the listing, the privacy policy and the terms. IMPORTANT - see the demo-account note: the bundled test account is disabled in a production release build, so a reviewer needs credentials provisioned in advance.

Test instructions:
1. Launch the app and accept the one-time health disclaimer.
2. Sign in. NOTE: the README's bundled test account is gated behind SupabaseConfig.testAccountEnabled, which lib/app_env.dart:60 rejects in a prod release build, so the 'Use test account' button is not shown. A reviewer account must be provisioned - see the demo-account field of this submission.
3. The dashboard shows the six modules. Open Care, then Diet, then Workout.
4. Open Breathe and run a guided breathing exercise.
5. Open Games to see the play-based learning.
6. Open Shop - entries link out to Amazon and iHerb with affiliate tags, disclosed in-listing and in the terms.
7. Open Premium to view the paywall. If the App Tracking Transparency prompt appears, either answer is fine.

Privacy:
• Data collected: Your progress through the modules, and account details since sign-in is required. Advertising identifiers are used for ads if you consent.
• Network: Authentication and progress sync run on our Supabase backend. Ads are served by Google AdMob. Shop entries open Amazon or iHerb in your browser.
• Location: Not requested and not used.
• Tracking: YES - the app shows ads through Google AdMob and, with your consent via the iOS App Tracking Transparency prompt, uses your device's advertising identifier for ad relevance and measurement. You can decline and the app remains fully usable.

If you need anything else, please email contact@safecodeg.com and we will respond within one business day.
